words.gloss_range: fronted independent pronoun that resumes the already named people of paradise and makes them the subject of a nominal tableau

words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) begins the ayah by re-identifying the people of paradise from 36:55 before any setting is named. The independent pronoun makes participant identity the base of the scene, so the shades, couches, and final reclining posture unfold around an already known group. The boundary from 36:55 is close and asyndetic: the assertion of delighted occupation turns directly into a visual tableau without a visible connector.

topics.headline: fronted pronoun re-centers the known group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with already identified participants, not with scenery or a new unnamed group.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as an independent third-person plural pronoun functioning as the subject of the nominal clause and resuming the prior people of paradise.

topics.headline: the prior assertion becomes a tableau
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the move from 36:55's announced state into 36:56's visual description without a fresh connector.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL boundary rows cohere with the pronoun's resumptive function: 36:56 continues the 36:55 scene while changing from assertion to description.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle that joins the paired noun phrase into the subject while also carrying togetherness pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the paired noun phrase coordinated with the pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) prevents the opening pronoun from standing alone. It coordinates {{ar:أَزْوَٰجُهُمْ}} ({{tr:azwājuhum}}) into the subject, so the paired counterparts share the scene's predicate rather than appearing as an added circumstance. The togetherness nuance survives as shared experience, but local case and attachment keep the particle primarily as coordination. The repeated hum sound across the pronoun and possessive suffix also makes that shared relation audible.

topics.headline: coordination makes the pairs co-subjects
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the paired counterparts belong inside the grammatical subject, not beside it as a secondary accompaniment.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following noun as conjoined with the pronoun, and QAC describes it as a nominative coordinated subject.

topics.headline: togetherness is semantic, not a replacement parse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle makes shared experience felt while grammar still gives equality by coordination.
topics.reason: The togetherness claim is valid as semantic pressure, but the nominative coordinated noun blocks making accompaniment the controlling syntactic parse.

topics.headline: sound repeats the possessive link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated hum sound reinforces the same referential group across pronoun and possessive suffix.
topics.reason: The surface sequence repeats the pronoun sound in the attached possessive suffix that refers to the same group.

words.prose: {{ar:أَزْوَٰجُهُمْ}} ({{tr:azwājuhum}}) is not a loose mention of companions. The possessive suffix binds the pairs to the resumed group as one pronounced unit, and the nominative coordination makes them co-participants in the same shade, couches, and reclining predicate. Lexically, the word can cover spouses, paired counterparts, kinds, and matching types; here the suffix narrows it toward their own companions while the broader pairing field keeps complementarity visible. Within the surah, the same pairing vocabulary moves from created pairs and kinds (36:36) to personal paradise companionship (36:56), and wider reward formulas keep paired companionship near shade and reclining scenes (2:25; 3:15; 4:57; 52:20).

topics.headline: possessed pairs share the predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the paired ones are grammatically inside the subject and share the whole scene, rather than being backgrounded companions.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative as a coordinated subject and carries a possessive suffix that attachment evidence links to the same resumed group.

topics.headline: spouse sense remains wider than a bare label
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that local companionship is selected from a wider pairing field, so the word carries complementarity as well as spousehood.
topics.reason: V4 preserves spouse, pair, kind, and counterpart branches, while the local possessive suffix and coordination narrow the active reference toward their own paired companions.

topics.headline: noun form presents established paired relations
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word names an established plural relation, not a new act of pairing occurring inside the ayah.
topics.reason: The local surface is a possessed broken plural noun, not a verbal pairing form, and the suffix compresses possession into the word.

topics.headline: created pairing becomes paradise companionship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a scale shift from creation-wide pairedness (36:36) to the paired companionship of the garden scene (36:56).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL inter-ayah rows give concrete recurrence at 36:36 and reward-scene associations at 2:25, 3:15, 4:57, and 52:20; these qualify the local word without overriding its possessive reference.

topics.headline: plural endings keep the scene communal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that plural sound links the subject phrase to the final plural predicate.
topics.reason: The repeated plural sounds across the pronoun, possessive suffix, and final participle reinforce the shared-state reading.

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes shade the surrounding medium of the scene. It does not merely place the subjects under a shade-source; it frames them as within shelter, and the phrase can serve both as the broad setting of the subject and as the environment in which reclining occurs. Because it comes before {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}), the ayah first opens a macro-space and only then narrows to the couch surface. The long preposition and genitive tanwīn in the following word also make the shade phrase cohere as a compact environmental unit.

topics.headline: interiority makes shade a medium
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the subjects are framed as immersed within sheltering shade, not simply placed below an object.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the shade noun as a locative complement and marks interiority rather than surface contact.

topics.headline: first preposition opens the spatial zoom
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the scene moves from broad environment to specific support rather than listing two flat locations.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence allows the shade phrase to function as a locative frame, and the following surface preposition supplies the narrower layer.

topics.headline: sound binds the shade phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase's compact cadence as the ayah enters the environmental layer.
topics.reason: The preposition's long vowel and the following genitive tanwīn form the audible boundary of the governed phrase.

words.prose: {{ar:ظِلَٰلٍ}} ({{tr:ẓilālin}}) is the ayah's first environment. Its genitive case is governed by {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), and its indefinite plural form leaves the shade open in extent, abundance, and kind rather than a single counted shadow. The root range supports shade, shelter, and canopy-covering, while the local reward setting selects protective shade rather than a phantom-like shadow or unrelated branches. The canonical canopy variant keeps an overhead-covering resonance, so the later canopied couches feel nested inside the same covering logic. The shade also answers the surah's earlier darkness image (36:37) by turning darkness into restful shelter, and it belongs to the reward-shade field seen in 4:57.

topics.headline: shade is the broad locative layer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that shade is not decoration; it is the governed macro-location into which the whole scene is placed.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive as the object of the preposition and attachment evidence links the phrase as a locative complement in the nominal clause.

topics.headline: indefinite plural leaves shade unbounded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the shade is presented as abundant and unmeasured, not as one familiar patch of shade.
topics.reason: The word is an indefinite broken plural with tanwīn, and the local plural shade sense is supported by V4 shade-cover entries.

topics.headline: shade and canopy shelter survive together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the shade feels like protective covering and layered shelter, while the local reward scene blocks darker or unrelated branches.
topics.reason: V4 includes shade, overhead-covering, and protection branches; the local noun, preposition, and paradise setting narrow them to sheltering shade and canopy resonance.

topics.headline: reward shade reverses earlier darkness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that shade here is a reward-space, not merely absence of light, and that it contrasts with the earlier night-sign darkness (36:37).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply a same-surah contrast at 36:37 and a reward-shade cognate at 4:57, both of which fit the local garden setting.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the word's heavy consonantal and vowel texture as it names the first spatial layer.
topics.reason: The row's sound claim is compatible with the displayed surface and with the variant note, while remaining an acoustic observation rather than a semantic replacement.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the governed couch noun that supplies the support surface

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) shifts the spatial frame from immersion in shade to contact with support. The particle governs the couch phrase and fits the final reclining predicate: the bodies are not merely located in a place but borne on a surface. Its obligation or dominance branches are not locally active; the physical support relation is selected by {{ar:ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ}} ({{tr:al-arāʾiki}}) and {{ar:مُتَّكِـُٔونَ}} ({{tr:muttakiʾūna}}). The two-preposition sequence, {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) then {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}), builds a clean environment-to-support layering.

topics.headline: surface contact selects support
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the bodily support relation: reclining rests on a surface, not only inside an environment.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the couch noun as a surface complement to the reclining predicate, narrowing broader senses of the particle to physical support.

topics.headline: second preposition narrows the zoom
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's spatial architecture: first a surrounding environment, then the precise surface of repose.
topics.reason: The local sequence contains two distinct prepositional complements, and attachment evidence warns against collapsing shade and couches into one location.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the support phrase entering as one continuous unit before the final predicate.
topics.reason: The preposition directly precedes the definite couch noun, forming a compact support phrase.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ}} ({{tr:al-arāʾiki}}) supplies the scene's middle layer: the definite supports inside the unbounded shade and before the final posture. The word names canopied or enclosed couches rather than plain seats, so the shade motif is repeated at the furniture level as privacy, honor, and shelter. The following {{ar:مُتَّكِـُٔونَ}} ({{tr:muttakiʾūna}}) selects the reclining-couch sense over a bare throne image. Its definite broken plural presents known multiple supports suited to the plural paired subject, and the rarity of the word in paradise couch scenes (18:31; 76:13; 83:23; 83:35) makes it specialized reward vocabulary. The possible garden-tree background can color the shelter image, but it remains etymological background, not the local sense.

topics.headline: couches form the middle spatial layer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the zoom from shade to furniture to body, with the couches bridging environment and posture.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the surface preposition as a locative support complement and sits between the shade phrase and reclining predicate.

topics.headline: canopied couch, not bare seat

topics.reason: The supplied lexical evidence supports canopied couch imagery, and local attachment to the reclining predicate narrows broad throne or seat glosses to couch support.

topics.headline: known multiple couches contrast unbounded shade

topics.reason: The article and broken plural mark definite multiple furnishings, contrasting with the preceding indefinite plural shade.

topics.headline: rare couch word belongs to a reward formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the couch noun is specialized paradise furniture and is regularly completed by reclining.
topics.reason: The contextual profiles mark the form as low-count and concentrated in paradise contexts, with a strong collocation to the reclining root and concrete parallels at 18:31, 76:13, 83:23, and 83:35.

topics.headline: hamza gives the couch word a break
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a small audible catch inside the ornate furniture word before the final predicate.
topics.reason: The surface includes an internal hamza, which supports the row's phonetic observation without changing lexical sense.

words.prose: {{ar:مُتَّكِـُٔونَ}} ({{tr:muttakiʾūna}}) is the nominal sentence's final predicate, not a finite event verb. Its nominative active-participle form defines the compound subject as being in settled repose, and the supplied non-canonical accusative contrast would only make reclining circumstantial. The participle's plural agreement distributes the posture across both the group and their paired counterparts. Lexically, the root points to leaning and supported rest, while Form VIII makes the repose self-involved and chosen; with {{ar:عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ}} ({{tr:ʿalā al-arāʾiki}}), the body yields its weight to a named support rather than merely sitting. The word closes the ayah after subject, shade, and couches, turning 36:55's delighted state into visible bodily repose, echoing the active-participle closure of 36:55 and preparing the provision scene of 36:57. It also joins the paradise couch-recline formula found with the couch noun (18:31; 76:13) and recontextualizes the banquet luxury associated with the same root at 12:31.

topics.headline: participle freezes reclining as state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reclining defines the subjects as a standing state, not as an event that begins in the ayah.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as a nominative active participle functioning as the predicate of the nominal sentence.

topics.headline: plural agreement shares the posture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reclining state applies to both the resumed group and their paired counterparts.
topics.reason: The participle agrees with the compound plural subject formed by the pronoun and the coordinated paired noun.

topics.headline: chosen reclining rests on support
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a posture of chosen supported ease, not mere sitting, passive placement, or abstract comfort.
topics.reason: The local Form VIII active participle and the couch support phrase select self-reclining with weight borne by support; broader cultural glosses are kept as posture pressure, not as independent sense claims.

topics.headline: final posture completes the paradise formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word completes a built scene: prior delight becomes visible repose, and the couch phrase receives its function.
topics.reason: The contextual evidence links the reclining participle with paradise or luxury scenes and with the couch noun, while the CRITICAL rows give concrete boundary links to 36:55 and 36:57 and cross-references at 12:31, 18:31, 52:20, and 76:13.

topics.headline: hamza and plural cadence mark closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the articulated catch and plural cadence as the ayah settles on its final state.
topics.reason: The standard surface preserves the internal hamza and closes with a plural active-participle cadence that echoes the adjacent participial closure at 36:55.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated group هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ, the nested phrases فِى ظِلَٰلٍ and عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ, and the predicate مُتَّكِـُٔونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Pairing supplies a relational unit, shade places that unit inside shelter, couches furnish a stable support, and reclining makes the support bodily received. The plural scene is therefore organized companionship rather than a list of isolated luxuries.

activation_trace.role: A counterpart joined to its mate supplies the relational unit that enters repose.
Covering shade supplies the enclosing shelter around the paired group.
The furnished couch in an enclosed chamber supplies the concrete place of repose.
Leaning on a support converts the setting into bodily ease and received support.

changed_reading.before: People, spouses, shade, couches, and reclining form a static inventory of paradise comforts.
changed_reading.after: A relationally paired group is spatially nested in shelter and bodily settled into received support.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of paired companions, protective shade, abiding place, and supported posture across أَزْوَٰجُهُمْ, ظِلَٰلٍ, ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ, and مُتَّكِـُٔونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Several focus branches converge on remaining held: companions cohere by a shared condition, shade functions as protective custody, the couch root contributes staying in a place, and the reclining root can carry fullness and retention. Repose becomes durable settlement rather than a pause between movements.

activation_trace.role: Companions joined by likeness or shared action supply social coherence beyond mere proximity.
Shade as protection and guarded ease turns enclosure into security.
Remaining in a place supplies permanence beneath the surface image of a couch.
Fullness and retention supply the image of abundance held without leakage or dispersal.

changed_reading.before: The ayah depicts a pleasant but temporary pause.
changed_reading.after: The ayah depicts a guarded settlement in which fitted companions remain together, the place is not left, and fullness is securely retained.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier bodies are held by collars with heads forced upward, and an imposed covering blocks sight; forgiveness then introduces a covering that preserves rather than disables. The focus shade and reclining support reverse both the ethics and the bodily geometry of enclosure: cover protects, and support permits voluntary ease.

activation_trace.role: A collar that binds an organ supplies coercive bodily holding as the negative pole.
The raised head unable to lower toward water supplies forced posture rather than ease.
A covering laid over something supplies enclosure whose effect is occlusion.
Covering the fault while protecting its bearer supplies the preserving alternative to blinding cover.
Protective shade converts enclosure into guarded ease.
Voluntary reliance on support reverses the earlier rigid and imposed posture.

structural_cues: The sequence 36:8-11 distinguishes bodily binding, sight-blocking cover, and preserving forgiveness before 36:56 combines shelter with relaxed support.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies harmful holding, harmful covering, and preserving covering; I infer an ethical and bodily reversal in the focus scene. Alternatively, the images may contrast punishment and reward only at a general level.

changed_reading.before: Shade and reclining indicate generic protection and comfort.
changed_reading.after: Cover and bodily support have been transformed from forced rigidity and blindness into voluntary ease under preserving shelter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The city witness crosses distance in purposeful motion, is told to enter the tree-screened garden, and names forgiveness and honor. His trajectory supplies an embodied route from strenuous public movement to the focus ayah's abiding, supported repose.

activation_trace.role: The farthest side supplies the distance from which the witness's movement begins.
Purposeful movement toward a sought end supplies effort and direction.
Entry into an interior supplies the threshold from motion to dwelling.
A garden screened by trees supplies the sheltered destination.
Protective covering of fault supplies the transition into safety.
Bestowed honor supplies the social dignity of the destination.
Abiding in place turns the witness's arrival into settled residence.
Supported reclining supplies rest after purposeful exertion.

structural_cues: 36:20-27 forms a compact movement, entry, forgiveness, and honor sequence that can orient the later garden tableau.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a witness who moves from the city's far side into forgiven and honored garden entry; I read the focus repose as a possible endpoint of that trajectory. Alternatively, the witness is an exemplar of the destination without defining every occupant in 36:56.

changed_reading.before: The reclining figures are anonymous occupants already at leisure.
changed_reading.after: Their repose can be read as honored arrival after costly purposeful movement, with effort resolved rather than forgotten.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first places all pairs within a created field that includes earth-growth, selves, and unknown kinds. When the same root appears in the focus, marital spouses remain the nearest reading, but pair can also carry fitted counterparts, kinds, and companions whose relation belongs to the wider order of creation.

activation_trace.role: Pairs as kinds or classes widen the repeated root beyond an exclusively marital scope.
Growth emerging from earth supplies the ecological domain in which pairing operates.
Living, productive earth grounds the paired order materially.
The self or very identity of a thing brings human pairings inside the same created pattern.
The spouse branch preserves the direct domestic reading in the focus.
A joined counterpart lets the domestic pair participate in the surah's broader relational order.

structural_cues: The exact focus root recurs at 36:36 inside an exhaustive sequence: earth-growth, selves, and what remains unknown.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit universal pairing statement and repeats its root in the focus; I infer that the local spouse sense is nested within that larger order. Alternatively, syntax may keep أَزْوَٰجُهُمْ narrowly marital despite the earlier widening.

changed_reading.before: أَزْوَٰجُهُمْ means only the marital spouses accompanying individuals.
changed_reading.after: The marital reading remains live, while the group also embodies creation's fitted pairs and kinds: companions joined by complementarity, likeness, or shared condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Descendants are borne in a filled vessel, people ride created conveyances, drowning remains possible, and rescue is attributed to mercy. The focus reclining root contributes both reliance on a support and, more distantly, tying a vessel; the couch can therefore be read as a safely bearing support rather than a badge of self-sufficiency.

activation_trace.role: Bearing a visible load supplies the basic relation between occupants and support.
The vessel moving in water supplies a support that carries bodies through danger.
Filling the vessel supplies held fullness rather than emptiness.
Riding on the back of a conveyance makes bodily dependence on support explicit.
Drowning supplies the failed-support alternative that makes safe bearing consequential.
Extraction from danger supplies rescue rather than autonomous survival.
Merciful tenderness supplies the stated cause of continued safe carriage.
Tying a vessel supplies a material image of contents securely held.
Leaning on support transfers the carried relation from transport to repose.

structural_cues: 36:41-44 repeatedly places human continuity on a bearer and makes rescue contingent; 36:56 again depicts bodies giving weight to a support.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies carrying, riding, failed carriage, rescue, and mercy; I transfer that support relation analogically from vessel to couch. Alternatively, the transport episode may only establish divine power and temporary preservation, not the material logic of the later furniture.

changed_reading.before: The couch is a self-contained luxury possessed by its reclining occupant.
changed_reading.after: The couch is a safely bearing support: repose acknowledges carried dependence, secure holding, and mercy after the possibility of failed support.

context_deltas.mechanism: The trumpet produces rapid emergence, the sleepers are stirred from their resting place, all are gathered and brought present, and action is recompensed. Reclining then follows as conscious stability after acceleration and adjudication, not as another form of deathlike sleep.

activation_trace.role: Rapid forward movement supplies the kinetic onset of resurrection.
Stirring what was still supplies awakening and renewed agency.
Sleep and stillness supply the former resting state from which they are awakened.
Joining what was dispersed supplies collective recomposition.
Presence and nearness supply accountable wakefulness before the focus scene.
Action met by its recompense supplies the completed adjudication that precedes repose.
Abiding in place supplies a new stable endpoint after the rush and gathering.
Supported reclining supplies wakeful ease rather than the former sleep of the resting place.

structural_cues: 36:51-56 moves through rushing, awakening, gathering, presence, recompense, delight, and finally reclining.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a tightly ordered change of bodily states; I infer that the second stillness in 36:56 is qualitatively transformed by the intervening awakening and judgment. Alternatively, reclining may simply be one reward image without deliberate contrast to مَرْقَدِنَا.

changed_reading.before: Reclining resembles passive or sleepy leisure.
changed_reading.after: Reclining is wakeful post-resurrection rest: accelerated bodies have arrived, been made present, and can now remain without compulsion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate frame calls the garden inhabitants occupied rather than vacant, marks their inward delight, gives them what they call for, and places a merciful word of peace over the scene. Bodily stillness therefore coexists with active enjoyment, relational availability, request, and receptive hearing.

activation_trace.role: Occupation as the opposite of vacancy blocks a reading of reclining as empty idleness.
Delighted inward ease supplies the affective quality of their occupation.
Calling or drawing by speech supplies active desire and available response.
Freedom from harm supplies the condition in which supported ease can remain open and alert.
An uttered word supplies an acoustic and relational event around the silent tableau.
Merciful tenderness identifies the source and tone of the peace addressed to them.
Paired counterparts keep the enjoyment socially organized rather than solitary.
Bodily support supplies stillness without canceling occupied delight or receptive attention.

structural_cues: The focus ayah is grammatically enclosed by 36:55, 36:57, and 36:58, which supply occupation, delight, desire, peace, and divine speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate active and acoustic framing; I infer that the reclining posture is receptive and engaged rather than vacant. Alternatively, شُغُل may denote an unspecified delight without requiring conversation or other outward activity.

changed_reading.before: Reclining is idle, private, and nearly mute.
changed_reading.after: Still bodies remain actively engrossed: paired enjoyment, callable desire, and reception of merciful peace coexist with repose.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus joins people to their azwaj; the next turn orders the criminals to sort themselves apart, and the following covenant distinguishes worshipful allegiance from the distant enemy. Togetherness in 36:56 is thus not undifferentiated gathering but a post-judgment affiliation among those fitted by relation or shared orientation.

activation_trace.role: Sorting a thing until it is distinct supplies the immediate opposite of the focus conjunction and pairing.
Cutting or severance sharpens the social consequence attached to the criminal designation.
A preserved covenant supplies the criterion by which affiliation is tested.
Submissive worship supplies the allegiance that can join a person to the wrong side.
Distance and severance supply the relational character of the prohibited allegiance.
Explicit enmity supplies the opposed social bond.
Companions sharing form, action, or condition supply the positive affiliation retained after sorting.

structural_cues: The joined tableau of 36:56 is followed almost immediately by the separation command of 36:59 and the allegiance test of 36:60-61.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conjunction, pairing, explicit sorting, and opposed allegiances; I infer that the focus companionship is one result of judgmental classification. Alternatively, أَزْوَٰجُهُمْ may remain strictly marital while the separation contrast operates only between larger groups.

changed_reading.before: Spouses are simply added to otherwise independent individuals.
changed_reading.after: Azwaj are also affiliates whose shared orientation survives sorting; togetherness itself is an outcome of judgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late instruction opposes grief's inward roughness to what people conceal and reveal. The concealment root also carries side branches of hidden joy and a place of reclining, so the visible couch scene can be read as interior serenity finally given an external, protected form.

activation_trace.role: Roughness of the soul through grief supplies the inward texture reversed by ease.
Concealing something in the interior supplies the hidden side of the contrast.
Hidden joy and ease supply an affective interior that can later become manifest.
A place of settlement and reclining provides a lexical side bridge directly back to the focus furniture.
Making something visible supplies external manifestation after concealment.
The visible furnished couch gives hidden ease a concrete exterior.
Protective shade keeps manifested ease from becoming exposure.

structural_cues: 36:76 explicitly coordinates grief, speech, concealment, and manifestation, while its concealment inventory contains both hidden joy and a reclining place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward grief, concealment, manifestation, and lexical side branches of joy and repose; I infer an interior-to-exterior movement toward the focus tableau. Alternatively, the side branches may be associative rather than a deliberate causal link.

changed_reading.before: The ayah displays visible luxury without specifying an inward transformation.
changed_reading.after: The protected resting place externalizes serenity: concealed ease becomes inhabitable and visible without becoming vulnerable exposure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading uses the branch-distant wound-healing image within the root of ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ, so it must not replace the ordinary couch sense. It remains anchored because the same focus root supplies a wound becoming sound and still, while context supplies pain, protective forgiveness, and grief; downstream prose should present it only as a convalescent echo.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root ء ر ك at word 6, especially B005, supported by protective shade at word 4.

activation_trace.role: Pain and hurt supply the damaged condition from which convalescence differs.
Protective covering of fault supplies repair from harmful consequence.
A wound becoming sound and its swelling quieting supplies the convalescent core of the outlier.
Protective custody supplies the sheltered conditions of recovery.
The soul made rough by grief supplies a nonphysical wound whose texture can also be calmed.

changed_reading.before: The couches signify status and luxury.
changed_reading.after: They may also carry a contained echo of convalescence: bodily and inward wounds have settled under protective cover.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The focus noun still denotes shade; this outlier activates its branch of water remaining under trees and the couch root's arak-tree branch. Springs and drinking make the material analogy coherent, but downstream prose should describe a water-conserving microclimate as an echo, not claim that ظِلَٰلٍ literally means pools.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root ظ ل ل at word 4 through B008, reinforced by the tree branch B001 of ء ر ك at word 6.

activation_trace.role: Wide splitting and outflow supply moving water within the garden ecology.
A flowing water source supplies the hydrological input to the shaded refuge.
Water retained beneath trees and away from sun turns shade into a sustaining microclimate.
The arak-tree branch supplies vegetation within the material analogy while the surface retains the couch sense.
A place or instrument of drinking supplies human access to the retained water.

changed_reading.before: Shade is only the visual absence of direct sun.
changed_reading.after: Shade may also evoke a vegetated, water-retaining refuge that materially sustains the bodies at rest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The closed-mouth branch of و ك ء is distant from the surface meaning reclining, so this is a contrastive acoustic echo, not a lexical gloss. It remains anchored in مُتَّكِـُٔونَ and gains context from the merciful word immediately after and punitive mouth-sealing later; downstream prose should qualify their quiet as possibly receptive rather than imposed.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root و ك ء at word 7 through B002, held against its ordinary reclining branch B004.

activation_trace.role: Peace free from harm supplies what the reclining group is available to receive.
An uttered word makes the quiet tableau acoustically receptive rather than empty.
Holding back and closing the mouth supplies the branch-distant possibility of quiet.
A preventing seal supplies the punitive form of imposed silence.
Opening the mouth in speech identifies the bodily channel that is sealed.
Meaningful speech transferred to the hands shows the consequence of the sealed mouth.

changed_reading.before: The reclining figures are silent because they are passive.
changed_reading.after: Their quiet may be unforced receptivity to a word of peace, sharply unlike the later mouths sealed while other limbs testify.

strongest_changes: Shade and bodily support become the preserving reversal of coercive collars, forced posture, and blinding cover.
The repeated pairing root and the later separation command widen azwaj from spouses alone toward fitted companions and post-judgment affiliation.
The resurrection sequence makes reclining wakeful rest after rushing, gathering, presence, and recompense rather than sleep or incapacity.
The immediate frame makes repose actively delightful and receptive, while the transport sequence makes it dependent on safe bearing and mercy.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context changed a static luxury tableau into a social and bodily topology: harmful holding becomes support, occluding cover becomes shelter, scattered movement becomes settled presence, and undifferentiated gathering becomes fitted companionship.
remaining_uncertainties: How far أَزْوَٰجُهُمْ should be widened beyond marital spouses to companions, kinds, or aligned cohorts.
Whether the vessel and hidden-interior branch analogies should shape final prose or remain diagnostic support only.
The convalescent, water-retaining, and receptive-silence readings are anchored but branch-distant and require explicit qualification.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Paired rest is layered protection.** `ز و ج` B002 is spouse; `ظ ل ل` B001 shade and B004 protective shelter; `ء ر ك` B004 a couch in a curtained chamber; `و ك ء` B004 leaning on support. Shade, chambered couch, and bodily support form nested layers. I infer that secure relationship and secure space mutually enable rest. The ayah reads as architected repose, not merely luxury.
2. **Leaning reverses compulsory uprightness.** Earlier collars forced heads upward (36:8), and cosmic bodies had to continue coursing (36:38-40). Here `و ك ء` B004 allows supported leaning. I infer that rest is the release from coerced or task-bound posture. The bodily image becomes a sign of completed security.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 36:65's speaking hands and feet sharpened the rest image: limbs formerly burdened with acquisition now need not act or defend, but can lean within settled safety.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Rest is a nested support system.** **ز و ج B002** anchors spouses and **ز و ج B001** paired counterparts; **ظ ل ل B001** supplies covering shade and **ظ ل ل B004** protective patronage; **ء ر ك B004** the couch inside a curtained chamber; and **و ك ء B004** leaning on support. The syntax supplies pair within shade upon couches in a reclining state. The inferred arrow is *relational, environmental, architectural, and bodily supports stack so no member must hold itself upright defensively*. Ease is produced by nested bearing.
2. **Settled placement answers the prior forced movement.** **ء ر ك B003** supplies remaining fixed in a place, while **و ك ء B004** supplies reliance. The local backward window has people driven from graves and brought present (36:51–53); the fixed ayah gives chosen-looking stillness after judgment. Those contrasts are supplied; the abduction is *completed arrival transforms compelled motion into stable residence*. Reclining marks terminal fit rather than inactivity.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: **Later surprise.** 36:58 adds the merciful Lord's utterance as the nonphysical support beneath every visible layer, and 36:59's sorting shows that this shelter is specifically assigned rather than ambient to all.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, evlilik ilişkisindeki erkeğin kadına ve kadının erkeğe göre eş olarak adlandırılmasını açıkça ortaklaştırır. Kadın eş için ayrı bir biçimin kullanılması kaynaklarda değerlendirilse de dalın kimliği iki yönlü evlilik bağıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal her türlü eş veya benzeri değil, yalnız evlilik bağı içindeki kadın ya da erkek kişiyi gösterir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın ad kullanımlarına dayanır; tanım evlilikteki eş rolünü kapsar ve genel çift anlamını buraya taşımaz.

concept_map.definition: Evlilik bağı içindeki iki kişiden, öteki kişiye göre eş konumunda bulunan kadın veya erkektir. Adlandırma iki cinsiyet için de kullanılabilir; kadın eşi açıkça belirten ayrı bir biçim de vardır.

facets.statement: Evlilikteki kadın ve erkekten her biri ötekine göre eş olarak adlandırılır.
Kadın eş, ortak adın yanında kadınlığı açıkça gösteren ayrı bir biçimle de ifade edilebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, evlilik bağı içindeki erkeğin kadının eşi, kadının da erkeğin eşi olduğunu ortak biçimde bildirir. Kadın eş için ayrı bir biçimin kabulü ve üslup değeri konusunda farklı değerlendirmeler bulunsa da temel karşılıklı ilişki değişmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı bir kişi ya da şeyi başka biriyle eş konumuna getirme çekirdeğinde birleştirir. Evlendirme, eş edinme ve iki tarafı bir araya getirme bu çekirdeğin düzenli gerçekleşmeleridir; erkek ve dişi olarak ayırma ise yalnız belirtilen kullanımda sınıflandırma yönü taşıyan sınırlı bir varyanttır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız evlilik eylemi değildir; ancak her türlü birleştirme veya sınıflandırmayı da kapsamaz, eş kurma ilişkisi korunmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın olmayan biçimler ve belirli söz öbekleriyle gerçekleşir; evlilik, genel eşleşme ve sınıflandırma kullanımları kendi kuruluş sınırları içinde ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi ya da şeyi başka biriyle karşılıklı eş konumuna getirmek veya böyle bir eş edinmektir. Bu çekirdek evlilikte eş sağlama ve eş edinme biçiminde gerçekleşebilir; belirli bir kullanımda erkek ve dişi olarak eşleştirme ya da sınıflandırma anlamına uzanır.

facets.statement: İki taraf birbirine eş olacak biçimde bir araya getirilir veya kendiliğinden eşleşir.
İnsanlar söz konusu olduğunda eylem birine eş sağlama ya da bir eş edinme biçiminde gerçekleşebilir.
Belirli bir kuruluşta eylem, topluluğu erkekler ve dişiler olarak eşleştirme veya sınıflandırma yönü taşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, iki tarafı birbirine eş kılmak ya da bir tarafın ötekini eş edinmesidir. Evlilik kuruluşları bu çekirdeği insanlar arasında özelleştirir; bir başka kuruluşta erkek ve dişi olarak eşleme ile sınıflandırma yorumları birlikte aktarılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, adın sayı bildiren bir çift yerine bir şeyin rengi, türü, çeşidi veya sınıfı için kullanıldığını açıkça gösterir. Bitki ve kumaş örnekleri bu sınıflandırıcı çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal zorunlu olarak iki öğe saymaz; bir bütün içindeki türü veya renk çeşidini adlandırır ve söz öbeğine bağlı örnekleri genelleştirmez.

Bitkiler, güzellik veya benzerlik niteliğiyle ayrılan çeşitler halinde adlandırılabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çekirdeği açıkça bir yerde kalmak olarak belirler ve bunu insanın yerleşmesiyle develerin yerlerinden ayrılmaması üzerinden örnekler; belirli bir otlakta kalan develer de aynı sınır içindedir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bir yerde kalma ve oradan ayrılmama yapılarıyla sınırlıdır; belirli ağacı yemek, yara iyileşmesi veya genel bir kök anlamı olarak genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca kişi ya da devenin bir yerde kalmasını bildiren yapılara bağlıdır; çıplak bir eylem anlamı olarak genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin bir yerde kalması veya develerin bulundukları yeri bırakmayıp orada durmasıdır. Belirli bir otlak türünde kalan develer, bu yerden ayrılmama çekirdeğinin özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da deve bulunduğu yerde kalır ve oradan ayrılmaz.
Belirli bir otlak türünde kalan develer, aynı kalma ilişkisinin özel örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir yerde kalma çekirdeğinde birleşir; insanın bir yerde oturması, develerin yerlerinden ayrılmaması ve belirli otlakta kalan develer bu çekirdeğin katılımcı ve bağlam çeşitleridir.

error_profile.loses: İnsan öznesini ve belirli otlakta kalma özel kullanımını kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sıradan bir yatağı değil, örtülü bir bölmede bulunan yatak ya da oturma tahtını tanımlar; bir kaynak bunu kubbe veya ev içinde döşenmiş ve süslenmiş olarak betimler, çoğul kullanım da aynı nesne türünü korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, örtülü bir bölmedeki yatak ya da oturma tahtıyla sınırlıdır; her yatak, barınak veya kalma yeri buna girmez, döşenmiş ve süslü olma ise tek bir kaynak betimlemesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, herhangi bir özel birleşime dayanmadan nesnenin çıplak adını verir ve başka dallardaki kalma ya da yer anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_gloss.applicability: Örtülü bir bölmede yer alan yatak ya da oturma tahtının genel karşılığıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yara iyileşmesini yalnızca ağrının dinmesi olarak değil, yaranın düzelip kapanmaya yönelmesi, şişinin inmesi ve bozulmuş dokunun ardından sağlıklı kırmızı etin görünmesi aşamalarıyla tanımlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Eylem yapısı rahatsızlığın ortaya çıkışını, biçim ise etkilenen develeri anlatır; ikisi neden olan besini ve karın şikâyetini birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kiside cinsel birlesmeye yonelik siddetli bir gereksinim bulunmasini belirli bir niteleme yapisi icinde verir. Dal cercevesi bu yogun cinsel ihtiyaci dogru yakalar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanim yalniz taniklanan niteleme yapisina baglidir; buradan kokun yalniz kullanimina ait genel bir cinsel istek anlami cikarilmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir niteleme yapisinda, bir kisinin cinsel birlesmeye siddetle ihtiyac duymasi ve isteginin yogun olmasidir.

facets.statement: Kisi cinsel birlesmeye yonelik siddetli bir gereksinim duyar.
Bu anlam, kisiyi yogun cinsel ihtiyaciyla niteleyen belirli bir soz yapisiyla sinirlidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Coklu kaynaklar arasinda ortaklastirilmis bir malzeme yoktur; dal tek ve yapisal olarak sinirli bir tanikliga dayanir.

source_details.summary: Tek taniklik, kisiyi cinsel birlesmeye siddetle ihtiyac duyan biri olarak niteleyen yapisal kullanimi bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Taniklanan niteleme yapisindaki yogun gereksinimi, eylemin kendisiyle karistirmadan verir.

error_profile.preserves: Cinsel alani, birlesme hedefini ve ihtiyacin siddetini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kisinin yogun cinsel gereksinimini niteleme biciminde anlatirken kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kisideki cinsel istegin siddetini ve niteleme islevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Ihtiyacin ozellikle birlesmeye yonelik oldugunu acikca belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal cok ve etkin bicimde cinsel birlesmede bulunmayi niteleyen davranissal bir ozelliktir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal yogun cinsel yonelim ve birlesme istegi alaninda yer alir.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam genel dogurma ya da dogum sancisi degil, devenin sancili dogum sirasindaki kivranma davranisidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanim, deve oznesiyle kurulan taniklanmis yapiya baglidir; insanin yaslanmasina veya genel dogum eylemine genisletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Devenin dogum sancisi sirasinda bedensel aciyla kivranip carpinmasidir.

facets.statement: Deve, dogum sancisi sirasinda aciyla kivranip carpinir.
Davranis, devenin dogum surecindeki sancili evreyle ve bu ozneyle sinirlidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, taniklanan yapinin devenin dogum sancisi sirasinda gosterdigi kivranma ve carpinmayi anlattiginda birlesir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hayvan turunu, dogum evresini ve sanciya bagli bedensel davranisi birlikte koruyan karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Deve oznesini, dogum sancisi kosulunu ve kivranma davranisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Oznenin deve oldugu acik bir baglamda dogum sancisina bagli davranisi akici bicimde verir.

error_profile.preserves: Dogum sirasindaki aci ve kivranma davranisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kendi basina kullanildiginda oznenin deve oldugunu belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal dogum surecinin sancili evresine aittir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu sancinin kendisidir; bu dal ise devenin o sanci sirasinda gosterdigi bedensel davranistir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu zaman ve hazirlik evresidir; bu dal sancili evrede ortaya cikan somut davranistir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, develerin yagla dolgunlasmasini, tulumun dolmasini ve insan karninda diskilamanin durmasini ayni bicim ailesinde taniklar. Dal doluluk ve icerigin disariya cikmamasi cercevesinde korunabilir, ancak fiziksel dolma ile bosaltimin tutulmasi tek bir sonuca indirgenmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal iki bagli sonucu ayirir: bir beden ya da kabin dolmasi ve karindaki atigin cikamayip tutulmasi.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanim, deve, insan karni ve tulum oznesiyle kurulan ayri yapisal kullanimlari korur; belirsiz inceleme birimini kesin bir genel anlama donusturmez.

concept_map.definition: Taniklanan yapilarda deve bedeninin yagla ya da tulum gibi bir kabin icerikle dolup dolgunlasmasidir; insan karninda ise atigin disariya cikamayip tutulmasini anlatir.

facets.statement: Bir beden ya da kap, ilgili icerikle dolarak dolgun bir duruma gelir.
Develer yagla dolup semiz ve dolgun hale gelir.
Tulum ya da benzeri bir kap icerikle dolar.
Insan karninda atik disariya cikamaz ve bosaltim tutulur.
Kalın derili tulum agziyla ilgili olumsuz kullanim taniklansa da pratik anlam siniri kaynakta acik degildir.

source_details.summary: Tek taniklik, develerin yagla ve tulumun icerikle dolmasini; insan karninda ise atigin cikmayip tutulmasini bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalin fiziksel doluluk ve karindaki atigin cikmamasi yonlerini ayri secenekler halinde korur.

error_profile.preserves: Beden ve kap dolulugunu, yagla dolgunlasmayi ve bosaltimin tutulmasini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Develerin yagla dolarak semiz ve dolgun hale gelmesi anlatilirken kullanilir.
